page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top right. Signature at the bottom left, catchword at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: fisset. Suos enim à Platina, Stella, & alijs nimium amasse dicitur, ita ut ea quae aliunde rapuisset, illis sine lege condonaret. Nam quibusdam nobilibus Romanis castella ui abstulit, ac suis dono dedit, & inter alia Surianum castrum. Gibellinus, fa-[?]tiofis[?] hominibus ad suas tyrannides defendendas, ubiq; restitutis, Florentiae & alibi pro suo libito magistratus posuit, & alia incommoda gessit. Proposuerat quoq; hic Pontifex, duos reges ex domo Vrsina, unum in Hetruria, & alterum in Lombardia creare. Sed dum haec perficere cogitasset, in Sutrio oppido existens, apoplexia correptus, anno Domini 1281, & quarto sui Pontificatus anno, subita morte sine loquela expirauit: cum tamen ex bona complexione, multo diutius uicturus crederetur. Quam mortem praedixisse quendam ferunt, per exundationem maximam Tiberis, quae tunc fe-bat. Hunc dicunt ex concubina filium generasse, crinibus & unguibus similem ursae. Vide Ioannem Noviomagum, in illustrationibus Bedae.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "fa-[?]tiofis[?]" on the line break at the foot of the first paragraph is hard to read; the word is probably a misprint or a corrupt form, so it is marked. The page number is read as 325 from a worn top-right numeral. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "fisset", "Vrsina", "ursae"). The "130." before MARTINVS is printed in the text column and is kept as part of the heading. The final "impe-" is treated as the catchword, not as text.
